safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports a tingling sensation around the lips.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling around the lips; generated facts only describe throat tingling/"something in the depths" and do not document lip tingling.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Perioral/lip tingling can be an early mucosal symptom of a systemic allergic reaction and contributes to assessing anaphylaxis risk. Omitting it could reduce diagnostic clarity and potentially delay escalation (e.g., epinephrine consideration) in a rapidly evolving reaction.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient denies any sensation of throat closing.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states the patient denies throat closing; generated facts describe throat tingling/abnormal throat sensation but do not document denial of throat closing.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting denial of throat-closing helps risk-stratify airway involvement in suspected allergic reactions. If omitted, the record may overstate airway threat, potentially leading to unnecessary emergency escalation/monitoring rather than direct patient harm.
